title: 第21章被墨居仁墨大师看上第22章废丹不这是我的筑基机缘
slug: 凡人修仙疯了吧你一百岁了还要修仙
content_zh:
;;
翌日，北寒风腰间挂着红皮葫芦，站在了丹殿的大门外。
抬头望去，整座丹殿被巨大的阵法结界笼罩着，这里的火属性灵气和木属性灵气都无比充沛，有一种灼热和清凉双交之感。
依照指引，北寒风找到了负责人事登记的执事弟子，递上了自己的身份玉牌。
负责登记的内门执事弟子修为在炼气八层，他接过北寒风身份玉牌时，眼中很讶异。
“北寒风？……你就是白师姐推荐进丹殿的那个百岁……天灵根？”
“是。”北寒风垂着眼睑，声音沙哑，看不出喜怒。
执事弟子拿着身份玉牌，打量了一下北寒风，特别在其身着的内门弟子服饰上停留了片刻，眼中满是轻蔑。
他登记好调任记录，把身份玉牌还回北寒风的同时，递来了一套练丹学徒服饰和一本《丹殿规仪》。
“去东侧第三偏殿报道，负责处理‘清心草’的淬炼。记住，丹殿重地，规矩森严，莫要行差踏错，否则严惩不贷。”
“谢师兄。”北寒风接过玉牌，衣物和书册，行了一礼后，便转身离开。
在他往东侧第三偏殿走去时，身后传来清晰的议论讽刺声。
“就是他？传说中的天灵根？……百岁了才炼气二层，怕不是假的天灵根吧？”
“听说是在废丹院待不下去了，托了白芷师姐的关系才塞进我们丹殿的。”
“啧，这么大年纪还来学炼丹？灵力操控跟得上吗？神识够用吗？简直是浪费资源……”
北寒风前走的脚步一顿，握着衣物和书册的手指紧了紧。随后又像没事人一样，继续往前走。
东侧第三偏殿比主殿小很多，但依旧宽敞。
殿内温度偏高，排列着数十个低矮的石台，每个石台前都坐着一名学徒弟子，正埋头处理着各自身前的清心草。
负责管理此殿的是一名姓王的内门执事弟子，炼气九层修为，面色严肃。
他给北寒风指了一个空着的空石台，丢下一句“每日需淬炼三筐清心草，”便不再理会。

北寒风换上学徒服，默默走到石台前。
他拿起石台上的一个玉简贴在额头，里面是清心草淬炼的标准流程。对拥有炼气八层真实修为的他，这要求并不难。
放下玉简，他拿起一株清心草，调动灵力，开始剔除其中的杂质，然后挤压草叶，引导汁液流入石台上的玉碗。
日子就这样一天天过去。
北寒风每日重复着淬炼清心草的工作，低调而沉默。
那些嘲讽和议论他声音，也因他的毫无反应，渐渐平息了下去。
这一日，殿内突然一阵骚动。
一位身着青色丹师袍、面容清癯的老者，在几名丹殿执事的陪同下，走入殿中。
“是墨居仁墨大师！”
“墨大师，可是能炼制筑基丹的存在！”
“他怎么来了？难道是来挑选学徒的？”
“机会来了！若能得墨大师看重，收为弟子，那可就一步登天了！”
“大家都打起精神……”
“………”
殿内所有的学徒都挺直了腰板，手下活也认真了几分，力求将自己最好的一面展现出来。

The next day, Bei Hanfeng stood outside the gate of the Alchemy Palace with a red leather gourd hanging around his waist.
Looking up, the entire Alchemy Palace is shrouded in a huge formation barrier. The fire attribute aura and wood attribute aura here are extremely abundant, and there is a feeling of burning heat and coolness.
Following the instructions, Bei Hanfeng found the deacon disciple in charge of personnel registration and handed over his identity jade tag.
The disciple of the inner sect deacon in charge of registration was at the eighth level of Qi refining. When he received the jade token of Bei Hanfeng's identity, his eyes were filled with surprise.
"Bei Hanfeng?...Are you the hundred-year-old Tianlinggen recommended by Senior Sister Bai to enter the Alchemy Palace?"
"Yes." Bei Hanfeng lowered his eyelids, his voice was hoarse, and he could not tell whether he was happy or angry.
The deacon disciple held the identity jade tag and looked at Bei Hanfeng, especially for a moment on the inner disciple's clothes he was wearing, his eyes full of contempt.
He registered the transfer record and returned the identity jade badge to Bei Hanfeng. At the same time, he handed over a set of alchemy apprentice clothes and a book of "Alchemy Palace Rules".
"Go to the third side hall on the east side to report and be responsible for handling the tempering of the 'Qingxin Grass'. Remember, the Dan Palace is an important place with strict rules. Don't make any mistakes, otherwise you will be severely punished."
"Thank you, senior brother." Bei Hanfeng took the jade token, clothes and books, bowed before turning and leaving.
As he walked towards the third side hall on the east side, clear sounds of discussion and sarcasm came from behind him.
"That's him? The legendary Heavenly Spiritual Root?... He only refined the second level of Qi when he was a hundred years old. Isn't it a fake Heavenly Spiritual Root?"
"I heard that he couldn't stay in the Wasted Alchemy Academy any longer, so he was admitted to our Alchemy Palace thanks to Senior Sister Bai Zhi's relationship."
"Tsk, are you here to learn alchemy at such an old age? Can you keep up with spiritual control? Is your spiritual consciousness enough? It's a waste of resources..."
Bei Hanfeng paused as he walked forward, and tightened his fingers on the clothes and books. Then he continued walking forward as if nothing had happened.
The third side hall on the east side is much smaller than the main hall, but still spacious.
The temperature in the hall is relatively high, and there are dozens of low stone platforms lined up. In front of each stone platform, an apprentice is sitting, immersed in handling the Qingxincao in front of them.
The person in charge of managing this hall is an inner sect deacon disciple named Wang, who has a ninth-level Qi refining level and a serious look on his face.
He pointed out an empty stone platform to Bei Hanfeng and said, "Three baskets of Qingxin grass need to be tempered every day," and ignored it.
Bei Hanfeng put on his apprentice uniform and silently walked to the stone platform.
He picked up a jade slip on the stone platform and put it on his forehead. Inside was the standard process for tempering Qingxincao. This requirement is not difficult for him who possesses the real cultivation level of the eighth level of Qi refining.
Putting down the jade slip, he picked up a Qingxin grass, mobilized his spiritual power, and began to remove impurities. Then he squeezed the grass blades and guided the juice into the jade bowl on the stone platform.
The days passed like this.
Bei Hanfeng repeats the work of tempering Qingxincao every day, low-key and silent.
The voices that mocked and discussed him gradually died down due to his lack of response.
On this day, there was a sudden commotion in the palace.
An old man with a pale face wearing a blue alchemy master's robe, accompanied by several alchemy hall deacons, walked into the hall.
"It's Master Mo Jurenmo!"
"Master Mo, you are the one who can refine the Foundation Building Pill!"
"Why is he here? Is he here to select apprentices?"
"The opportunity has come! If you can get the respect of Master Mo and accept him as a disciple, you can reach the sky in one step!"
"Everyone cheer up..."
"..."
All the apprentices in the hall straightened their backs and took their work more seriously, striving to show their best side.
